blocks.text: LIMA — Peruvian rights groups on Tuesday slammed a plan by the government to ban girls from wearing short skirts or nail polish in school and forbid boys from having long hair. During a visit to a school on the outskirts of Lima, right-wing President Keiko Fujimori, who was elected in July on a law-and-order platform, said: “Order should not only reign in the streets, it must also return to our schools, our classrooms.” She outlined a raft of measures, from permanently expelling “the most unruly students” from the education system, to banning makeup and hair dye, or long locks on […]...
